title: Control API status
description: I0: what the control API's GET /status returns: the install's newest generation, why the newest manifest or secrets were refused if they were, and the state of each world and each data-layer service. A child's state is its own report (B1), or unknown when it has not reported for three of its reporting intervals.

refused.description: Why the newest manifest or secrets were refused. The generation above keeps running.

override.description: The last time vhd apply restarted worlds that may have had players online, as the server manager confirmed: the generation it applied, and each such world's player count, or null where status could not say.

worlds.description: Each world of the install, keyed by its save name.

services.description: Each data-layer service of the install, keyed by its name.

published.description: The generation this world's runtime has been handed. Absent until the world is first handed one, which vhd apply does.

pending.description: A newer generation this world waits for.

waits_for.description: Why the newer generation waits. vhd apply: it changes the world's container, which only vhd apply recreates. an empty world: it restarts the game, so it waits while players may be online; vhd apply --disconnect-players applies it now.

removed.description: The manifest no longer has this world. Its container runs until vhd apply removes it.

state.description: The runtime's state as it last reported it, or unknown when it has not reported recently.

report.description: The runtime's last report, as contracts/game-runtime.status.schema.json defines it, which the control plane validated on arrival. Its required keys are repeated here, not referenced: check-jsonschema cannot follow a reference that leads on to a third file.

published.description: The generation this service has been handed. Absent until vhd apply first creates its container.

pending.description: A newer generation this service waits for: vhd apply, since the service has no container yet and only vhd apply creates one. A service never waits for an empty world.

state.description: The service's state as it last reported it, or unknown when it has not reported recently.

report.description: The service's last report, as contracts/service.status.schema.json defines it, which the control plane validated on arrival. Its required keys are repeated here, not referenced: check-jsonschema cannot follow a reference that leads on to a third file.
